asked: # Build savings-mid Do these three small steps in order: s1 write notes/a.md with the sum of the numbers in src/a.txt; s2 write notes/b.md with the largest number in src/b.txt; s3 write notes/c.md with the line count of src/c.txt. Mark each done with build-progress as you finish. No branch, no PR. Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first. Progress: this build's progress file is the console's view of where you are. After each step run `node framework/cli/build-progress.mjs step <stepId> done --note "<one line>"` (and `step <next> running` when you start one; `note "…"`, `link --branch <b> --pr <n>`, `status blocked --note "why"` when stuck). It is a local file write: carry straight on. Never stop to update the console, the orchestrator, THREADS.md or the build log between steps; the reconciler folds the file into the builds store by itself. AXF_BUILD_ID=savings-mid is set for you.
